records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net sales were $482.1 million, an increase of 16.7% from the $413.1 million in 2021;

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Gross profit was $196.7 million, a 41.9% increase, compared to the $138.6 million in 2021;

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net income was $72.7 million, or $1.59 per diluted share, compared to $39.5 million, or $0.87 per diluted share, in 2021; and

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Gross profit margin improved 720 basis points to 40.8% from 33.6% in 2021;

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Operating income increased 96.4% to $93.1 million, or 19.3% of net sales, compared to $47.4 million, or 11.5% of net sales, in 2021;
